messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Block diagonal matrix
parts:
We don't have a block-diagonal matrix structure.

If it's data, define a dense matrix either as data or
transformed data. If it involves parameters, define
it in transformed data.

If that's not efficient enough, you need to write
the block operations yourself as Stan functions in the
Stan program.

- Bob
